rationale: VRDN has gapped up ~12.4% on no news catalyst, with a 114 bps bid-ask spread and high relative volume suggesting a volatile, news-driven move that is already fading from the session high of $29.74 — the last four candles show a sharp rejection and consolidation well below that high. The wide spread and lack of a clear directional catalyst make risk/reward unfavorable in either direction; the stock is mid-range with no structural level to anchor a clean stop, and I already have committed short exposure in the portfolio. Sitting out preserves capital and loss budget for higher-conviction setups.
